item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC Women 3-1 Briton Ferry Llansawel
item.description: Rosie Hughes scored an inspired brace as Wrexham AFC Women claimed a 3-1 victory over Briton Ferry Llansawel in North Wales. Grace Evans opened the scoring for the visitors after just seven minutes, but Katie Barker equalised just seven minutes later from the spot. Hughes earned Wrexham a lead for the first time with 62 minutes played, as Barker produced an important cross before Wrexham’s number nine headed home from close range. item.title: LOANED OUT | Andy Cannon heads to Burton Albion
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm midfielder Andy Cannon will move on loan to Burton Albion until the end of the 2025/26 season. Back-to-back-to-back promotion winner Cannon, 29, has recovered from the ACL injury he suffered in the win against Mansfield Town last February. Having returned to full training, the midfielder – who has scored 12 goals in 88 appearances for Wrexham – will now head to the Pirelli Stadium. item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Date confirmed for Bristol City away clash
item.description: Our away fixture against Bristol City will now take place on Tuesday February 17 at 7:45pm. The original fixture was scheduled to take place on Friday February 13 live on Sky Sports Main Event but was postponed due to both club’s progression in the Emirates FA Cup. All ticket and travel information for the fixture at Ashton Gate will be released to supporters in due course.

item.title: PRE-SEASON | Wrexham AFC to face Wisła Kraków to celebrate Polish club’s 120th anniversary match
item.description: Wrexham AFC will travel to Poland in pre-season to take on Polish 1.Liga leaders Wisła Kraków in a match to celebrate the hosts’ 120th anniversary. Founded in 1906, Wisła Kraków are 13-time Polish champions and were founder members of the Ekstraklasa. The match is provisionally scheduled to take place on July 11, 2026, and is to be played at Synerise Arena Kraków. Full fixture information will be confirmed in due course. item.title: TICKET NEWS | Bristol City (A) on sale to supporters from Friday
item.description: Tickets for our away fixture against Bristol City on Tuesday, February 17th, will go on sale to supporters from 10am on Friday, January 30th. We have been allocated 1500 tickets for the match at Ashton Gate, which kicks-off at 7.45pm. Tickets will go on sale to season-ticket holders at 10am on Friday. As per our usual ticket procedure for away fixtures, an allocation of 30% of the tickets will be held back to go on sale to members from 2pm. Any remaining tickets will be released to general sale
